title: FB-004 block close while queue source scan runs
summary: Make queue source scans visible to backend close-readiness and avoid daemonized scan abandonment.
reason: Worker finding FR-008 identified that queue source-scan workers are daemonized and not consulted by close-readiness, allowing shutdown to abandon scan and subprocess cleanup work.
behavior_before: Queue source scan started a daemon thread recorded only in queue service state. Process close-readiness did not ask the queue service about active source scans.
behavior_after: Queue source scan starts a non-daemon thread, exposes an active-scan close-readiness block message, and the process guard blocks shell close or launch actions while the scan thread is alive.
tests_added: Python queue source-scan test proving scan threads are non-daemon and expose active-scan block messages.
Python close-readiness test proving an active queue source scan blocks safe close.
